_meta.notes: Hand-curated starter set for the hackathon. Heights and colors are approximate typical mature values for rendering, not botanical reference. 'invasive_banned' = on Indiana's Terrestrial Plant Rule (312 IAC 18-3-25); verify any status against in.gov/dnr before showing it to users as fact. 'invasive_listed' = on the Indiana Invasive Species Council list but not banned from sale.
